# GetWebMCP
> The Developer Adoption Hub for W3C WebMCP (document.modelContext).

- Website: https://getwebmcp.dev/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/weihao-m/getwebmcp
- W3C Specification: https://github.com/webmachinelearning/webmcp
- Coding Agent Guide: https://getwebmcp.dev/agent.md

## Core APIs
- document.modelContext.registerTool({ name, description, inputSchema, execute })
- document.modelContext.getTools()
- document.modelContext.executeTool(tool, args)
- document.addEventListener('toolchange', callback)

## 1-Line Setup Prompt for AI Agents
"Read https://getwebmcp.dev/agent.md and implement WebMCP tools for this codebase."
